VanillaPsycastsExpanded.PsycasterPathDef.label: Deepcaller
VanillaPsycastsExpanded.PsycasterPathDef.description: Deepcallers reach down through the rimworld's crust to something old, hungry, and patient. They raise writhing limbs from the ground to guard what is theirs — and the deep grows stronger with every offering it is fed.
VanillaPsycastsExpanded.PsycasterPathDef.tooltip: Deepcallers summon evolving tentacles to control and defend territory.
